title: Kestrel Finance Tier Rate Sheet: Score Bands, Terms and Contract APRs
content:
Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts are written at one of six credit tiers. This rate sheet sets, for every tier, the credit score band and entry conditions, the terms that may be written, the contract APR for each term before any autopay reduction, the autopay APR reduction and the day-count basis used for daily simple interest.

## Tier entry conditions

| Tier | Credit score band | Minimum credit score | Minimum months at current job | Open bankruptcy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 500 to 579 | 500 | 6 | not allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 580 to 619 | 580 | 6 | not allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 620 to 659 | 620 | 3 | not allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 660 to 699 | 660 | 0 | not allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 700 to 759 | 700 | 0 | not allowed |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 760 to 850 | 760 | 0 | not allowed |

## Terms offered and contract APR by term (percent, before any autopay reduction)

| Term (months) | Tier E | Tier D | Tier C | Tier B | Tier A | Tier A+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 36 | 22.99 | 18.99 | 14.99 | 11.49 | 8.49 | 6.99 |
| 48 | 23.49 | 19.29 | 15.29 | 11.79 | 8.79 | 7.29 |
| 60 | 23.99 | 19.59 | 15.59 | 12.09 | 9.09 | 7.59 |
| 66 | not offered | 19.89 | 15.89 | 12.39 | 9.39 | 7.89 |
| 72 | not offered | not offered | 16.19 | 12.69 | 9.69 | 8.19 |
| 75 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | 9.99 | 8.49 |

Terms offered, restated per tier: Tier E 36, 48 and 60 months; Tier D 36, 48, 60 and 66 months; Tier C and Tier B 36, 48, 60, 66 and 72 months; Tier A and Tier A+ 36, 48, 60, 66, 72 and 75 months. A term marked "not offered" cannot be written at that tier.

## Autopay reduction and day-count basis

| Tier | Autopay APR reduction (percentage points) | Day-count basis for daily simple interest |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 0.25 | 365 days |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 0.25 | 365 days |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 0.50 | 365 days |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 0.50 | 365 days |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 0.50 | 365 days |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 0.50 | 365 days |

## Reading the sheet (hypothetical look-ups)

- A Tier B contract written for 66 months carries 12.39 percent before any autopay reduction; the same term at Tier A carries 9.39 percent.
- A 75-month term appears only in the Tier A and Tier A+ columns; at Tier C the longest term on the sheet is 72 months.
- A score of 619 sits in the Tier D band (580 to 619); a score of 620 sits in the Tier C band.
- The day-count basis is 365 days at every tier; the autopay reduction is 0.25 percentage points at Tier E and Tier D and 0.50 percentage points at Tier C and above.
